note: Published 31 October 2025. States that "The Red Hill Agricultural & Horticultural Society - proud custodians of the Red Hill Show since 1922" took over management of the market "in 2024", that it runs "on the first Saturday of each month" at "the Red Hill Recreation Reserve", 9am-2pm, free entry. Read first hand on 2026-09-14. Evidence for register item A25 on the succession date: local press dates the handover to 2024, which is the season the Red Hill Community Market last traded at that ground.
